title: Safe passage
giver: any working person (any profession) after a few conversations in a culture's town
offered: they complain about moving goods and hand over a load; the goods and the complaint depend on the profession
objective: carry 12 of the goods to the named town within 4 weeks and talk to a worker there
reward: a carrying fee from the destination town's wage pool, halved if late
note: Optional misc quest. Opens Found a company.
